scope: The same reading keys everywhere, Blank on every empty line, and full text selection.

topics.title: Say all
details: Press Insert+Down Arrow to read from your place to the end. Caps Lock+Down Arrow does too.
Or say say all, or read from here.
Insert+Up Arrow reads the line you are on.

topics.title: Select text by voice
details: To choose text by voice, say select, then a word for the part.
The parts are character, word, line, sentence and paragraph.
Say select next word or select previous line to choose the next or last one.
Say extend selection by word to add to what you chose.
Say select to end of line, or select to the end.
These now work in email you read, the Document reader, web pages and Help too.
Say copy to copy what you chose.

topics.title: The same keys everywhere
details: The arrows work as in JAWS and NVDA on every screen with text.
Control+Left and Control+Right move by word. They stop at each line end and each empty line.
In Help, Up and Down now move by line, and Control+Up and Control+Down by paragraph.
In a note, the arrows read the note when the typing box is empty.

topics.title: Blank lines
details: An empty line is always said as Blank. Before, some email lines said nothing.
The end of a line says Blank too.

topics.title: Selecting with Shift
details: Shift and an arrow now say only what changed, such as Selected b or Unselected b.
Control+A says All text selected. It no longer reads all of the text.
